title: Sparse Hodge Preference Optimization: Fine-Tuning Language Models toward Alignment beyond Transitive Preferences
abstract: arXiv:2611.30135v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The growing adoption of Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), which leverages pairwise preference data, reflects its great success in fine-tuning large language models to align with human expectations. It directly optimizes the policy from human preferences without explicit reward modeling or the complexities of reinforcement learning-based approaches. However, the classic DPO relies on the Bradley--Terry sampling model and cannot effectively capture intransitivity or cyclic structures in aggregated human preference data. In this article, we propose Sparse Hodge Preference Optimization (SHPO), a preference optimization algorithm that augments DPO with a sparse antisymmetric curl residual motivated by the combinatorial Hodge decomposition. We prove that SHPO strictly enlarges DPO's hypothesis class on comparison graphs containing at least one triangle, under some mild regularity conditions on the response representations. translated_title: 稀疏霍奇偏好优化：微调语言模型以实现对超越传递性偏好的对齐
translated_abstract: 直接偏好优化的广泛应用，反映了其在利用成对偏好数据微调大型语言模型以符合人类期望方面的巨大成功。它直接从人类偏好中优化策略，无需显式的奖励建模，也避免了基于强化学习方法所带来的复杂性。然而，经典的DPO依赖于Bradley-Terry采样模型，无法有效捕捉聚合的人类偏好数据中的非传递性或循环结构。在本文中，我们提出了稀疏霍奇偏好优化，这是一种偏好优化算法，通过受组合霍奇分解启发的稀疏反对称旋度残差来增强DPO。我们证明了在响应表示满足一些温和正则性条件的情形下，SHPO在包含至少一个三角形的比较图上严格扩大了DPO的假设类。我们进一步……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出稀疏霍奇偏好优化（SHPO），借助组合霍奇分解理论为DPO引入稀疏反对称旋度残差，使其能够捕捉人类偏好数据中的非传递性与循环结构，并证明其严格扩大了DPO的假设类。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Sparse Hodge Preference Optimization (SHPO), which augments DPO with a sparse antisymmetric curl residual motivated by combinatorial Hodge decomposition to capture intransitivity and cyclic structures in preference data, and proves it strictly enlarges DPO's hypothesis class.
